title: Scraper: ASUS Server (EPYC KMPP/KRPA/KRPG/K14PA)
description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

Goal: Scraper for ASUS server motherboards. Distinct from the existing consumer ASUS scraper — server boards live on servers.asus.com with a different SubSpec/SystemCode taxonomy in the same odinapi.

board_class: EPYC.

Sockets/board families to cover:
- SP3: KRPA-U16, KRPG-U8, KMPP-D32 (Naples/Rome/Milan)
- SP5: K14PA-U24, K14PA-U12-Z (Genoa/Bergamo)
- SP6: K14PG-U-Z and similar Siena boards

Access strategy:
- Catalog: https://servers.asus.com/products/Servers/Server-Motherboards lists all current AMD EPYC server boards (13 motherboards visible at survey time).
- Same odinapi.asus.com SeriesFilterResult endpoint as the consumer scraper, but with **different SystemCode/ProductLevel codes** (probably SystemCode=asuswebstorage or asus-servers, ProductLevel1Code=server-workstation). First task is to capture the XHR call from a browser dev-tools session and document the right parameters.
- BIOS file API: same www.asus.com/support/webapi/ProductV2/GetPDBIOS works for server SKUs once you know the model name (verified during survey for consumer; likely identical for server).
- CDN: dlcdnets.asus.com — same as consumer. ASUS capsule unwrap (strip 0x800-byte header) probably applies to server CAP files too; confirm during implementation.

Implementation notes:
- Heavy code overlap with consumer AsusScraper. Either:
  1. Duplicate as src/psp_etl/scrape/asus_server.py, share the _strip_html / _extract_agesa helpers via a small _common module.
  2. Add a 'category' parameter to AsusScraper that selects SubSpec set + base catalog URL.
- Recommend (1) for now — the SystemCode/ProductLevel parameters are different enough that a parameter-driven design will be brittle.
- ASUS server uses ASMB1x BMC firmware that's bundled separately; this scraper only fetches the BIOS, not the BMC.

License-safe references: none in surveyed prior art covers ASUS server.

Acceptance criteria:
- Class at src/psp_etl/scrape/asus_server.py
- Tests with fixture API responses for catalog + BIOS list
- classify_board_class returns EPYC for SP3/SP5/SP6 (already wired)
- CLI registration

Related: #79, #81.
